verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents temporary tokens as an alternative to long-lived API keys. These give time-limited access with a 30-second TTL for real-time applications, which partially serves least-privilege credentials for agent clients. The evidence shows no permission or scope restriction on those credentials, and nothing on issuing credentials per agent. Missing for 10: scope/permission-limited API keys (e.g., restricting to the Voice Agent endpoint only), per-agent credential issuance or management, configurable TTL or revocation details, and independent corroboration.
